def head(h):

from collections import Counter
def f1(y,p):
    fs=[]
    for c in range(4):
        tp=((p==c)&(y==c)).sum(); fp=((p==c)&(y!=c)).sum(); fn=((p!=c)&(y==c)).sum()
        fs.append(2*tp/(2*tp+fp+fn))
    return np.mean(fs)
